title: ZX Bank ATMs at Major Colleges & Universities (City-Wise)

nodes.title: Mumbai, Maharashtra
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Mumbai institutions: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay) at its Main Gate in Powai, and University of Mumbai (Kalina Campus) near the Administrative Block in Santacruz East.

nodes.title: Delhi, National Capital Territory
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Delhi institutions: University of Delhi (North Campus) outside the Central Library, and Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) near Sabarmati Hostel on New Mehrauli Road.

nodes.title: Bangalore (Bengaluru), Karnataka
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Bangalore institutions: Indian Institute of Science (IISc) near the Main Canteen in Malleshwaram, and Christ University at the Main Entrance Gate on Hosur Road.

nodes.title: Hyderabad, Telangana
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Hyderabad institutions: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT Hyderabad) at the Hostel Block in Kandi, Sangareddy, and Osmania University on Arts College Road.

nodes.title: Chennai, Tamil Nadu
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Chennai institutions: Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IITM) near Himalaya Mess, and Loyola College at the Main Gate on Sterling Road, Nungambakkam.

nodes.title: Kolkata, West Bengal
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Kolkata institutions: Jadavpur University at Gate No. 4 on Raja S C Mallick Road, and University of Calcutta (College Street Campus) near the Main Auditorium at 87/1 College Street.

nodes.title: Pune, Maharashtra
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Pune institutions: Savitribai Phule Pune University at the Main Entrance in Ganeshkhind, and Symbiosis International University near the Library at its Viman Nagar Campus.

nodes.title: Ahmedabad, Gujarat
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Ahmedabad institutions: Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad (IIMA) at Gate 1 in Vastrapur, and Gujarat University at the Vice-Chancellor Block.

nodes.title: Surat, Gujarat
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Surat institutions: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology (SVNIT) at the Administrative Block in Ichchhanath, and Veer Narmad South Gujarat University (VNSGU) at the Main Gate on Udhna Magdalla Road.

nodes.title: Jaipur, Rajasthan
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Jaipur institutions: Malaviya National Institute of Technology (MNIT) at the Front Gate on JLN Marg, and University of Rajasthan near the Law College on JLN Marg.

nodes.title: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Lucknow institutions: Indian Institute of Management Lucknow (IIML) at the Hostels Entrance in Prabandh Nagar on Sitapur Road, and University of Lucknow near the Main Library on University Road.

nodes.title: Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Kanpur institutions: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur (IIT Kanpur) in the Hall of Residence Area at Kalyanpur, and Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University (Kanpur University) at the Admin Block in Kalyanpur.

nodes.title: Nagpur, Maharashtra
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Nagpur institutions: Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology (VNIT) at the Main Gate on South Ambazari Road, and Rashtrasant Tukadoji Maharaj Nagpur University at the Vice-Chancellor's Office on Amravati Road.

nodes.title: Indore, Madhya Pradesh
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Indore institutions: Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore) at the Hostel Complex on Khandwa Road, Simrol, and Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya (DAVV) at the Takshila Campus on Khandwa Road.

nodes.title: Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Bhopal institutions: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER) Bhopal at the Main Gate in Bhauri, and Barkatullah University at the Main Admin Office on Hoshangabad Road.

nodes.title: Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Visakhapatnam institutions: Indian Institute of Management Visakhapatnam (IIM Vizag) at the Main Gate of Andhra University Campus, and GITAM (Gandhi Institute of Technology and Management) at the Main Building in Rushikonda.

nodes.title: Patna, Bihar
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Patna institutions: Indian Institute of Technology Patna (IIT Patna) at the Hostel Area in Bihta, and Patna University at the Main Campus Gate on Ashok Rajpath.

nodes.title: Vadodara (Baroda), Gujarat
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Vadodara institutions: The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda at the Fatehgunj Main Gate on University Road, and Parul University at the Main Gate in Limda, Waghodia.

nodes.title: Ludhiana, Punjab
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Ludhiana institutions: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) near the Students' Counselling Centre, and Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College at the Main Admin Block near Gill Park on Gill Road.

nodes.title: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
nodes.summary: ATMs at two Coimbatore institutions: PSG College of Technology at the Main Gate on Avinashi Road, Peelamedu, and Coimbatore Institute of Technology (CIT) at the Admin Block on Avinashi Road, Civil Aerodrome Post.
